honing_confound: Enhanced Weapon grants Crit Rate +30% from the rear (back-attack position). This compounds with gear crit stats at T4 — strong back-attack positioning compounds disproportionately with T4 Crit gear.

delivery.evidence: Deadeye uses three weapons: shotgun (close range, massive damage), handguns (medium range, rapid fire), rifle (long range, precision). Enhanced Weapon emphasizes back-attack with all three weapon types.

footprint.evidence: Shotgun = small cone at close range. Handguns = small single-target or burst. Rifle = line/point at long range. Mixed footprint across weapon types.

geo_text: Enhanced Weapon Deadeye is a triple-weapon back-attack specialist. The class uses all three weapon types but must attack from the rear (+30% Crit Rate from back). Shotgun at close range delivers the highest burst; rifle at long range for precision; handguns for rapid between-weapon cycling. The identity management is position-discipline (always behind) + weapon rotation.

control.evidence: Some skills have knockback on impact. No CC identity.

defense.evidence: Light-armor gunner. Very good mobility for repositioning. Back-attack requirement demands high mobility.

economy.resource_verbatim: Weapon Gauge (switches weapon modes; fills via combat)
economy.builder_source: Dealing damage fills Weapon Gauge. Different weapon-mode skills are available based on active weapon mode. Enhanced Weapon identity provides bonus when weapon gauge is charged and empowered attacks are used.
economy.plain_text: WEAPON SWITCHING ECONOMY: Deadeye switches between shotgun/handgun/rifle mode. Enhanced Weapon: when the weapon is 'enhanced' (powered state), skills deal additional damage. Exact enhanced-weapon trigger mechanism — kb from training; specific Ark Passive implementation not verified from live sources. Core: build gauge → enter enhanced state → deal amplified damage; back-attack for +30% crit bonus.

element.evidence: Gunfire-based Physical damage across all three weapon types.

movement.evidence: Deadeye has very good repositioning mobility — necessary for back-attack requirement. Some skills include dash components. Shotgun skills require very close positioning.

attr.evidence: Triple weapon range profile: shotgun = melee/0-5m; handgun = 5-15m; rifle = 20-30m. Enhanced Weapon uses all three — effective range varies by weapon mode.

range.evidence: Shotgun: 0-5m; Handgun: 5-15m; Rifle: 20-30m. Must switch modes for different range engagement.

tempo.evidence: Enhanced Weapon creates amplified damage during enhanced-weapon state. Burst windows when weapon gauge is charged.

amp.value: Back-attack: +30% Crit Rate; Enhanced Weapon state: amplified skill damage
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Back-attack Crit Rate bonus well-documented. Enhanced Weapon state bonus not verified from live sources in this session.

commitment.evidence: Shotgun skills have significant wind-up (close positioning + heavy charge). Rifle skills are precision charges. Handgun skills are faster.

mechanics_notes: 1) Enhanced Weapon is the 'master of all weapons' Deadeye identity — using all three weapon types fluidly for optimal back-attack output. The skill expression is managing weapon-mode switches, back-attack positioning, and enhanced-weapon state. HIGH MECHANICAL DEMAND class. 2) Deadeye is male-coded counterpart to Gunslinger (same three-weapon archetype, different model). Enhanced Weapon Deadeye = Peacemaker Gunslinger equivalent in structure. 3) Back-attack requirement on a class that must close to shotgun range then retreat to rifle range creates a 'yo-yo' positional game unique to Deadeye. 4) PISTOLEER comparison: Pistoleer Deadeye removes shotgun and rifle, locks to handguns, for simpler management. Same 'remove complexity, gain sustained output' pattern.
stabilization_patch: Enhanced Weapon has been the dominant Deadeye identity in boss content due to shotgun burst ceiling.
tier_standing_current: B/C-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: back-attack + crit compound is strong at T4 but Deadeye overall is outperformed by Gunslinger.

honing_confound: Pistoleer's handgun damage scales with Swiftness (cast speed). Rapid cycling advantage at high Swiftness compounds at T4. Tier standing reflects sustained output at full Swiftness investment.

delivery.evidence: Pistoleer locks to handgun-only skills. Dual pistol rapid fire attacks at medium range. No shotgun or rifle delivery.

footprint.evidence: Handgun skills hit at medium range in small burst patterns. Fan Shot creates a spread-shot AoE. Overall smaller footprint than Enhanced Weapon's shotgun close-range blasts.

geo_text: Pistoleer Deadeye uses handguns ONLY (shotgun and rifle modes locked). This removes the weapon-switching overhead entirely. All skill at medium range. High-Swiftness rapid-fire cycling creates a sustained output feel. Pistoleer engraving: handgun damage increased; removes shotgun/rifle.

defense.evidence: Same mobility profile. Less need for aggressive repositioning (no close-range shotgun requirement).

economy.resource_verbatim: Weapon Gauge (handgun mode only in Pistoleer)
economy.builder_source: N/A — Pistoleer removes weapon switching. Handgun skills fire on cooldown.
economy.plain_text: HANDGUN-ONLY COOLDOWN ECONOMY: No weapon switching, no shotgun/rifle modes. All skills are handgun-type on independent cooldowns. Pistoleer identity provides flat handgun damage bonus. Economy simplifies to 'fire handgun skills as they come off cooldown.' Similar to FI Wardancer's simplification of the Esoteric system.

movement.evidence: Same mobility profile. Medium range removes the shotgun close-range dash requirement. More freedom for continuous positioning.

attr.evidence: Handgun range — medium engagement distance. No close-range shotgun requirement.

tempo.evidence: Pistoleer is sustained: rapid-fire handgun cycling without burst windows.

amp.value: Handgun damage bonus (Pistoleer identity); high Swiftness provides faster cycling

commitment.evidence: Handgun skills are faster cast than shotgun/rifle. Pistoleer's high Swiftness makes skills nearly instant-fire.

mechanics_notes: 1) Pistoleer follows the 'remove complexity for flat bonus and sustained output' pattern: removes dual-weapon switching for focused handgun amplification. Same pattern as FI Wardancer, Reflux Sorceress, Energy Overflow Soulfist, Control Glaivier. 2) Pistoleer Deadeye has the BEST MOBILITY of all Deadeye builds — medium range + no shotgun close-range requirement + high Swiftness = can continuously reposition without DPS loss. 3) Pistoleer vs Enhanced Weapon mirrors Gunslinger Time to Hunt vs Peacemaker: one identity removes weapon complexity for simplicity; the other masters all weapons for a higher ceiling. 4) Deadeye overall has lower base damage than Gunslinger per most community assessments — both classes share the triple-weapon concept but Gunslinger is generally preferred.
stabilization_patch: Pistoleer is the secondary choice historically.
tier_standing_current: C/B-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Swiftness dependency means Pistoleer improves more at higher honing tiers where stat budget expands.
